notes: לָכֵן is fused to the single *Wherefore* and headed on the opening לְ, treating it as rule 23's pair of particles alongside כַּאֲשֶׁר; heading on כֵּן as the content-carrying morpheme, on the model of לִפְנֵי and בְּתוֹךְ, was the competing reading, and MACULA's assignment of the compound lemma to the first segment supports the choice made.
The suffix of הִנְנִי takes the English subject pronoun *I* under rule 18 while the particle keeps *Behold*.
